rules.note: a KO'd ally is exactly HP 0; the absolute predicate is used because a percent floors a 1-HP high-max ally to 0 too
heal the weakest wounded ally; the MP predicate is the reserve that keeps at least 8 MP after the cast
self-heal below 40% while still holding the MP reserve
otherwise take the engine-offered action on the weakest enemy
never-use-item by default: consumables are disabled, so this rule stays disabled and the party consumes nothing

player.note: Healer preset for every player-side actor without its own character assignment. Ordered revive -> heal ally -> heal self -> attack; every choice still comes only from the engine-legal candidates the adapter supplies.

policy_document.note: A6 resource/recovery preset. Consumables stay disabled (no `consumables` flag), so the item rule cannot fire; the MP reserve is the remaining_mp_after_cost predicate. A learned heal is never a candidate by itself -- the engine must offer it.
